description: Defines the ParsedCookie class for parsing, validating, and manipulating HTTP cookies, including attributes like path, domain, expiration, security flags, and other cookie properties.

classes.name: net::ParsedCookie
classes.description: Represents a parsed HTTP cookie with methods for validation, attribute access, and modification.

methods.name: ParsedCookie
methods.description: Constructor that parses a cookie string according to RFC6265bis, optionally providing a status output.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the parsed cookie is valid.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the cookie's name.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the cookie's value.

methods.name: HasPath
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has a Path attribute.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the Path attribute value.

methods.name: HasDomain
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has a Domain attribute.

methods.name: Domain
methods.description: Returns the Domain attribute value.

methods.name: HasExpires
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has an Expires attribute.

methods.name: Expires
methods.description: Returns the Expires attribute value.

methods.name: HasMaxAge
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has a Max-Age attribute.

methods.name: MaxAge
methods.description: Returns the Max-Age attribute value.

methods.name: IsSecure
methods.description: Checks if the Secure flag is set.

methods.name: IsHttpOnly
methods.description: Checks if the HttpOnly flag is set.

methods.name: SameSite
methods.description: Returns the SameSite attribute as an enum, optionally providing the string representation.

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Returns the Priority attribute.

methods.name: IsSameParty
methods.description: Checks if the SameParty attribute is set.

methods.name: IsPartitioned
methods.description: Checks if the Partitioned attribute is set.

methods.name: GetTruncatingCharacterInCookieStringType
methods.description: Returns the type of truncating character used in the cookie string.

methods.name: NumberOfAttributes
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes in the cookie.

methods.name: SetName
methods.description: Sets the cookie's name.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the cookie's value.

methods.name: SetPath
methods.description: Sets the Path attribute.

methods.name: SetDomain
methods.description: Sets the Domain attribute.

methods.name: SetExpires
methods.description: Sets the Expires attribute.

methods.name: SetMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the Max-Age attribute.

methods.name: SetIsSecure
methods.description: Sets the Secure flag.

methods.name: SetIsHttpOnly
methods.description: Sets the HttpOnly flag.

methods.name: SetSameSite
methods.description: Sets the SameSite attribute.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Priority attribute.

methods.name: SetIsSameParty
methods.description: Sets the SameParty attribute.

methods.name: SetIsPartitioned
methods.description: Sets the Partitioned attribute.

methods.name: ToCookieLine
methods.description: Returns the cookie as it would appear in an HTTP header.

methods.name: FindFirstTerminator
methods.description: Finds the first terminator character in a string.

methods.name: ParseToken
methods.description: Parses a token from a string segment.

methods.name: ParseValue
methods.description: Parses a value from a string segment.

methods.name: ParseTokenString
methods.description: Parses a token string.

methods.name: ParseValueString
methods.description: Parses a value string.

methods.name: ValueMatchesParsedValue
methods.description: Checks if a value matches its parsed version.

methods.name: IsValidCookieName
methods.description: Validates a cookie name.

methods.name: IsValidCookieValue
methods.description: Validates a cookie value.

methods.name: CookieAttributeValueHasValidCharSet
methods.description: Checks if attribute value has valid characters.

methods.name: CookieAttributeValueHasValidSize
methods.description: Checks if attribute value size is valid.

methods.name: IsValidCookieNameValuePair
methods.description: Validates a name/value pair for cookies.

methods.name: ParseTokenValuePairs
methods.description: Parses token-value pairs from cookie string.

methods.name: SetupAttributes
methods.description: Initializes attribute indices.

methods.name: SetString
methods.description: Sets a string attribute for the cookie.

methods.name: SetBool
methods.description: Sets a boolean attribute for the cookie.

methods.name: SetAttributePair
methods.description: Helper to set attribute key/value pairs.

methods.name: ClearAttributePair
methods.description: Removes an attribute key/value pair.
